description: A React component for editing a channel header in Mattermost, including modal UI, input handling, validation, and save logic.

classes.name: EditChannelHeaderModal
classes.description: React component class for editing a channel header within a modal dialog.

methods.name: handleModalKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key down events on the modal, specifically to close on ESCAPE.

methods.name: setShowPreview
methods.description: Updates the preview state for the header.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Handles changes to the header input, including validation for length.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Saves the updated header to the channel via patchChannel API call.

methods.name: blurTextbox
methods.description: Removes focus from the header input textbox.

methods.name: handleEntering
methods.description: Focuses the textbox when modal is entered.

methods.name: handleKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key down events within the input, including line breaks and Ctrl+Enter.

methods.name: handleKeyPress
methods.description: Handles key press events, including submitting on Enter.

methods.name: renderError
methods.description: Renders validation or server error messages.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the modal dialog with input, buttons, and error messages.
